resources.string: If the desktop closes by itself

Android 12 and newer can stop apps that run many background processes, which a full desktop does.

Android 14 and newer: open Settings → About phone, tap Build number 7 times, then go to Settings → System → Developer options and turn on “Disable child process restrictions”.

Android 12 and 13: connect the phone to a computer with USB debugging and run:
adb shell settings put global settings_enable_monitor_phantom_procs false
